purpose: Define known-truth and known-failure tests any future Chi_bio candidate must pass before real-data internal qualification.

KT_STABLE_WELL_SEPARATED.truth: candidate scalar exists and is safely inside stable regime

KT_NEAR_BOUNDARY.truth: candidate scalar exists close to model-native boundary
KT_NEAR_BOUNDARY.required_behavior: uncertainty widens appropriately and no false certainty is allowed

KT_UNSTABLE.truth: candidate scalar exists beyond model-native stability boundary
KT_UNSTABLE.required_behavior: recover correct regime after candidate-specific freeze

KT_DEGENERATE_MODES.truth: leading mode/eigenspace is degenerate or nearly degenerate
KT_DEGENERATE_MODES.required_behavior: subspace-aware uncertainty or refusal; no arbitrary eigenvector certainty

KT_NONNORMAL_TRANSIENT.truth: asymptotically stable spectrum with strong transient amplification
KT_NONNORMAL_TRANSIENT.required_behavior: scalar may remain stable but companion modal/system warning must remain visible

KT_MULTIPLE_INTERNAL_ORGANIZATIONS.truth: distinct modal/conglomerate organizations share similar scalar value
KT_MULTIPLE_INTERNAL_ORGANIZATIONS.required_behavior: do not claim scalar equivalence implies full-system equivalence

KF_NO_COHERENT_SCALAR.truth: no scientifically coherent system-level scalar compression exists

KF_NONIDENTIFIABLE.truth: multiple materially different generators fit observables equally

KF_REPRESENTATION_MISMATCH.truth: source representation cannot support frozen candidate mapping

KF_STATIC_ONLY_DYNAMIC_CLAIM.truth: only cross-sectional data are supplied to a dynamically interpreted candidate

KF_POSTHOC_UNITY.truth: unity is created solely by after-the-fact rescaling
KF_POSTHOC_UNITY.required_behavior: hard contract rejection before scientific evaluation

pre_scale_rules: Run smallest analytically checkable cases first.
Every pass criterion must be shown to fail on at least one known-bad case.
Do not tune tolerances after inspecting real cancer Chi_bio placement.
Pilot one representative production-equivalent synthetic case before broad parameter sweeps.
Checkpoint broad sweeps by case family and parameter cell.
Unchanged deterministic failures are not retried.
extension_rule: Once a candidate generator is scientifically selected, freeze its equations, truth parameters, parameter grid, noise model, estimators, tolerances, and refusal expectations before running outcome-bearing real data.
